cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Resolution-independent 3D text labels, automotive HUD reticles, vector icons, and CAD dimension overlays at low atlas resolutions
Explaining why bilinear interpolation across a single-channel min(d_L, d_R) bisector crease rounds off sharp corners
Reconstructing sharp intersections of affine half-planes via the 4-op branchless shader median(r,g,b) operator
Supporting both sharp bevels (via MSDF median) and true outer rounded glow/drop-shadows (via alpha channel scalar SDF in MTSDF)
not_for: Organic blobby metaballs where smooth C^1 polynomial smin blending is desired instead of sharp corners
Ultra-tiny sub-8px bitmap pixel fonts that snap directly to integer screen pixels without distance-field magnification
Complex self-intersecting (>3 edges meeting at a single point) vector junctions without sub-texel subdivision
Neural typography diffusion or text-to-vector font synthesis models (DeepSVG / VecFusion)
